title: Interactive AI Agent for Explainable Demand Forecasting in CPG
description: Develop an interactive AI agent for Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies to address black-box forecasting issues. The agent ingests forecast data (numerical demand, historical sales, product metadata in CSV/JSON from internal systems or public datasets; synthetic/anonymized data acceptable; high quality with timestamps, normalization, anomaly tagging; no PII). It provides natural language explanations of demand trends, key influencing factors, and anomaly alerts. Features include data upload, Q&A interface, visualizations (charts/graphs), and integration with forecasting system APIs. Success criteria: 85% user comprehension score, accurate anomaly detection, positive usability feedback. Demo with live upload and queries. Explore creative solutions aligned with objectives.
business_case_summary:
Business Case Summary: Interactive AI Agent for Explainable Demand Forecasting in CPG (DEM-2026-0011)

Executive Summary
This first-of-kind project develops an interactive AI agent for CPG demand forecasting, ingesting CSV/JSON data to deliver natural language explanations, visualizations, Q&A, and anomaly alerts.

Direct Business Value/Impact
Improves supply chain accuracy and decision-making by addressing black-box forecasting issues, targeting 85% user comprehension and positive usability feedback.

Potential Risk Mitigation
Medium risks addressed via synthetic data (no PII), live demo prototypes, and defined success metrics for anomaly detection and integration.
